usage: React (TSX) component ports of the best patterns. Props-driven, zero extra deps.

react_components.title: Bento features (React)
react_components.description: Asymmetric Memphis bento: hard shadows, squiggles, a rotated sticker card. Deliberately never three equal cards.

react_components.title: Deploy CTA (React)
react_components.description: Laboratory-clean call to action: a typed deploy command with calibration meta, spec table and a single measured button.

react_components.title: FAQ accordion (React)
react_components.description: Scandi-calm accordion: hairline dividers, serif numerals, a plus that folds into a cross. One open at a time.

react_components.title: Tabbed features (React)
react_components.description: Blueprint-styled tabs where every feature reads like a labeled schematic figure with spec tables and corner registration marks.

react_components.title: Luxe footer (React)
react_components.description: Near-black footer with champagne numerals marking each quiet serif link row. Translated from the luxe footer pattern.

react_components.title: Editorial hero (React)
react_components.description: Mono eyebrow, oversized Fraunces headline, hairline meta row, arch graphic and a rotated margin label. Translated from the editorial hero pattern.

react_components.title: Vaporwave hero (React)
react_components.description: Amber-to-rose slitted sunset disc over a perspective grid floor, chrome Unbounded headline, on-air mono row. Translated from the vaporwave hero pattern.

react_components.title: How it works (React)
react_components.description: Museum-placard steps: sticky roman numerals beside catalog-numbered placards with hairline rules.

react_components.title: Logo ticker marquee (React)
react_components.description: Industrial-brutalist ticker: numbered condensed Anton wordmarks scrolling under a hazard stripe, orange diamonds, factory spec plate below.

react_components.title: Mega menu nav (React)
react_components.description: Swiss-rational top bar with numbered items and a full-width hover panel of link columns, red index markers throughout.

react_components.title: Newsletter form (React)
react_components.description: Cottage-warm signup card with a stamp-like border and a React-state success note. No page reload, no false promises.

react_components.title: Honest pricing matrix (React)
react_components.description: Comparison matrix that lists what each plan leaves out, not just what it includes. Fine-print strip included.

react_components.title: Terminal stats readout (React)
react_components.description: Stats rendered as a phosphor-terminal session: command line, dotted leaders, meter bars, scanlines, blinking block cursor.

react_components.title: Testimonial wall (React)
react_components.description: Offset masonry wall of quotes in Parisian chic: serif pull quotes, atelier numerals, no two cards alike.
